Create a new Maven module or project to isolate the external library for clear separation of concerns.

Development environment and tools (e.g., IDE, version control) are properly set up.

activities.activity_description: Update build configuration (e.g., Maven pom.xml) to prevent external libraries from overriding existing ones in the uber-jar output, ensuring dependency conflicts are resolved.

activities.activity_name: Create New Project for External Library
activities.activity_description: Set up a new Maven module or project structure, move the external library code, update dependencies, and integrate it into the build system.

activities.activity_name: Port SFTP Module from XD to s-c-s
activities.activity_description: Migrate the SFTP module code from the Spring XD repository to the Spring Cloud Stream repository, adapting for compatibility, testing integration, and ensuring functionality.
Develop a new project to encapsulate all rules associated with the RedisRule contract, isolating it from core functionalities and making it reusable for test coverage.
Design and implement the infrastructure to support out-of-the-box processor modules in the streaming pipeline, including interfaces, base classes, and initial testing.
Modify the AetherModuleResolver to allow pulling module artifacts from a local Maven repository instead of remote repositories, adding configuration options.
Create a ModuleRegistry implementation that provides a service to look up module coordinates by name, including data storage and retrieval mechanisms.
Implement CLI commands: module info, module list, module register, and module unregister to interact with the ModuleRegistry, using a framework like Spring Shell.
